entities.summary: Arnold Frank Hills was an English businessman, sportsman, philanthropist, and activist. He notably made an appearance for the England national football team in 1879. Hills was an advocate for temperance and vegetarianism, serving as president of the London Vegetarian Society and Vegetarian Federal Union.
